name: meeting-notes
description: Record meetings, transcribe English/Hindi/Hinglish with speaker labels, and create Minutes of Meeting.

scripts.test: node wav.test.js && node meeting.test.js && node calendar.test.js && node groq.test.js && node meeting-link.test.js && node speakers.test.js && node worklet.test.js && node mom.test.js && node transcribe.test.js
scripts.build:watcher: swiftc -O -target arm64-apple-macos14 mic-watch.swift -o bin/mic-watch-arm64 && swiftc -O -target x86_64-apple-macos14 mic-watch.swift -o bin/mic-watch-x64 && lipo -create bin/mic-watch-arm64 bin/mic-watch-x64 -o bin/mic-watch && rm bin/mic-watch-arm64 bin/mic-watch-x64

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Meeting Notes records your microphone to transcribe meetings.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Meeting Notes records meeting audio to transcribe it.
